title: Diaspora Agent Index — live AI reads across the directory
excerpt: Which AI assistants are reading 2,000+ diaspora businesses, right now. Live counts, top listings, top metros.
content_html:
AI assistants are reading this directory every day — checking listings, answering questions, sending customers to diaspora businesses. These are the live numbers, straight from our access logs. No projections, no padding: named AI crawlers and assistants only.

Is AI reading your business?

Every listing here is machine-readable by design: open JSON API, llms.txt, MCP server, A2A agent card. Claiming is free while your listing is unclaimed — once it's verified, AI assistants can see that too.

Find your business and claim it

Run an agent? The directory is built for you: open API · MCP server · A2A agent card · llms.txt · machine-readable reads feed at /api/v1/reads · week-over-week analysis in the Weekly Agent Report.

Put a live AI-read counter on your own site for any listing:

<script src="https://nibiashara.com/ai-reads.js" defer data-b="your-listing-slug"></script>

What a "read" is: one row in our access log per AI visitor, per page or API answer, per day, from a named AI crawler or assistant (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Meta, Apple, DuckDuckGo, You.com, ByteDance and Common Crawl families). Generic bots, SEO tools, search-engine crawlers and our own monitors are excluded, as are flagged requests. Counts only — we never publish user agents, queries or anything per-visitor. Refreshed every two minutes; this page reloads itself every two minutes.
